partners.mechanism_chain: CEP290 (HGNC:23998) —DISRUPTS→ Basal body organization (GO:0005931); Basal body organization (GO:0005931) —LEADS_TO→ Cilium assembly (GO:0031012); Cilium assembly (GO:0031012) —LEADS_TO→ Joubert syndrome (MONDO:0012432); PCNT (HGNC:8723) —DISRUPTS→ Centrosome function (GO:0005814); Centrosome function (GO:0005814) —LEADS_TO→ Basal body organization (GO:0005931); Basal body organization (GO:0005931) —LEADS_TO→ Microcephalic osteodysplastic primordial dwarfism type II (MONDO:0008872).
